{{dablink|For other uses of the word "heaven," see [[Heaven]].}}
The '''Fists of Heaven''' is an elite [[Seanchan]] military group conveyed to battle by ''[[to'raken]]''. These are perhaps the only specialized airborne soldiers in all of Randland. Members of the Fists of Heaven are generally female and of small stature because of the space limitations aboard a ''to'raken''. Included in them is another elite group, the [[Bloodknives]].
